name: flow-field
title: Flow field
description: A wind map: streamlines of a slowly turning, swirling flow, with bright streaks that travel along them and leave fading tails.

name: voronoi
title: Voronoi Cells
description: A cellular surface like soap foam, crackle glaze or raised stone tiles, with walls of one width and seeds that drift so cells swell, shrink and trade edges.

name: galaxy
title: Galaxy
description: A tilted spiral galaxy turning slowly, with a bright core, arms with knots of stars, dust lanes and fixed stars behind.

name: moire
title: Moiré
description: Two fine gratings of lines, rings or mesh laid over each other and sliding slowly, so huge interference bands bloom, sweep and turn across the box.

name: rain
title: Rain
description: Rain on a window at night: soft out-of-focus city lights behind the glass, beads that show them brighter like tiny lenses, and bigger drops that slide down in jerky runs and leave wet trails.

name: black-hole
title: Black Hole
description: A black hole with a thin photon ring and a hot accretion disk seen at a slant, its far side lensed over the top and under the bottom, streaming round with one side brighter.

name: fire
title: Fire
description: Flames rising from the edge of the box, with a hot base, tapering tongues that lick up and tear off, and embers that drift above them.
